name: Flesh Hound

bonuses.name: Collar of Khorne
bonuses.text: This Threat may attempt to Deny the Witch once each Turn as if it had the PSYKER Keyword (Wrath & Glory, p. 267), with a roll of 10 dice.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test

abilities.name: Chilling Howl
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All enemies in earshot must make a DN 3 Terror Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

mobAbilities.name: Fury of the Pack
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of 10 or more Flesh Hounds gains +1 Defence and +2 bonus dice to attack rolls as long as each member is attacking the same target.
